answer: Tie every identity to a scarce, verifiable resource — a compute attestation or refundable stake — so each identity costs its creator real value. Publish identities in a registry, like plants tied to a garden trellis: the structure forces each newcomer to declare its sponsors, so fakes stand out and clones cannot hide. Price minting above what a fake can earn, as a jade carving is priced above its rough stone: a sybil pays dearly for each face while an honest agent pays once. Anchor each identity's history immutably on the ledger, so one burned fake can never resurface under a new name.
